h2.1: Ready to Engineer Your Next Industrial Process?
p.0: Gausin International Engineers Pvt. Ltd. is a leading industrial engineering company headquartered in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh India. We specialize in the Design, Engineering, Fabrication, and supply of Technologically Advanced Industrial Process Equipment.
p.1: Our portfolio spans Evaporators, Dryers, Milk Chilling Centres, CIP systems, Heat Exchangers, Pressure Vessels, Waste Management, ZLD, and complete Turnkey Process Plants - serving Dairy, Pharmaceutical, Food & Beverage, Chemical, Distillery, Pulp & Paper, and Energy Industries across India and Internationally.
p.2: We integrate cutting-edge engineering software and precision manufacturing technology to deliver solutions that are accurate, efficient, and future-ready.
p.3: Partnering with 200+ companies across India and internationally
p.4: Our team of expert engineers is ready to analyze your requirements and propose the most efficient, cost-effective solution tailored to your specific industrial needs.

card.desc.0: Advanced process simulation, mass & energy balancing, P&ID and Equipment Layout development for precise engineering designs.
card.desc.1: State-of-the-art fabrication using CNC, laser cutting, and precision welding - compliant with ASME, PED, and Indian Standards.
card.desc.2: Complete project management from concept to commissioning - including site installation, testing, and operator training programs.
card.desc.3: Thermal energy audits, TVR/MVR upgrades, multi-effect evaporation systems, and heat recovery solutions reducing operating costs significantly.
card.desc.4: Smart industrial automation with PLC/SCADA systems, IoT-enabled monitoring, and digital control interfaces for modern plants.
card.desc.5: Expert plant troubleshooting, performance optimization, process scale-up guidance, and regulatory compliance consultancy services.
card.desc.6: We leverage AutoCAD, CHEMCAD, HTRI, and advanced simulation tools to engineer equipment that performs beyond expectations.
card.desc.7: All equipment is designed and fabricated conforming to ASME, PED, BIS, and other applicable international engineering standards.
card.desc.8: Our multi-effect evaporation and heat integration systems significantly reduce steam and electricity consumption - lowering your OPEX.
card.desc.9: CNC machining, laser cutting, and precision TIG/MIG welding ensure every component meets the highest quality benchmarks.
card.desc.10: From initial process design through to commissioning, training, and post-installation support - we partner with you for the long term.
card.desc.11: Every plant and system is uniquely engineered to your process requirements, feed characteristics, and production targets.
fp.desc.0: High-efficiency multiple effect evaporator of various types viz. falling film, forced circulation, rising film and plate evaporator.
fp.desc.1: Convert liquid feed to free-flowing powder in seconds. Available in co-current, counter-current, and mixed flow configurations.
fp.desc.2: Integrated dairy plant solutions - from raw milk reception to pasteurization, homogenization, UHT, and packaging-ready output.
fp.desc.3: Complete environmental solutions including ETP/STP treatment plants, biogas & CNG, scrubber systems, incinerators, and water treatment for regulatory compliance.
fp.desc.4: Custom-fabricated stainless steel storage tanks and pressure vessels meeting ASME Sec. VIII and Indian boiler regulations.
fp.desc.5: High-performance thermal heat exchangers designed for maximum energy transfer efficiency in demanding industrial environments.
